scene_description: Two children walk along a wooden path covered in fallen autumn leaves in a forest. The child in the foreground wears a blue coat, an orange shirt, and yellow boots. A second, smaller child walks ahead on the path wearing a yellow jacket.

questions.question: What color are the boots on the child in front?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the feet of the child closest to you.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people on the path.

questions.question: What color is the coat on the child in front?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the jacket the closest child is wearing.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground under the children's feet.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is scattered all over the wooden path.
